description: This file defines a static class 'Slug' with extension method 'GenerateSlug' that converts input phrases into URL-friendly slugs by cleaning and truncating the string, using regular expressions for character replacement.

classes.name: Slug
classes.description: A static class providing functionality to generate URL slugs from text phrases.

methods.name: GenerateSlug
methods.description: Converts a string into a URL-friendly slug by removing invalid characters, collapsing spaces, trimming length, and replacing spaces with hyphens.

methods.name: InvalidCharsRegex
methods.description: Returns a regex that matches invalid characters in a slug.

methods.name: MultipleSpacesRegex
methods.description: Returns a regex that matches multiple whitespace characters to collapse them into a single space.

methods.name: TrimRegex
methods.description: Returns a regex used to replace whitespace characters with hyphens in the slug.
